title: Captain Paul W. Bud Bucha VA Medical Center Act of 2025
short_title: Captain Paul W. Bud Bucha VA Medical Center Act of 2025
committees: H-Veterans' Affairs Committee: Referred To 2025-07-23 [Health Subcommittee: Referred 2025-12-19]
latest_action: Received in the Senate. Read twice. Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 458.
summary: Captain Paul W. "Bud" Bucha VA Medical Center Act of 2025 This bill designates the medical center of the Department of Veterans Affairs in West Haven, Connecticut, as the Captain Paul W. "Bud" Bucha Department of Veterans Affairs Medical Center or the Captain Paul W. "Bud" Bucha VA Medical Center.

journey.note: Passed the House; waiting on the Senate
